name: spec-forge
description: Turn a confirmed design decision into a spec-trio-ready spec.md and BACKLOG.md draft, checked by a deterministic lint.

interface.shortDescription: Draft a spec from a confirmed decision
interface.longDescription: Gate a confirmed design decision, then lint the spec.md, BACKLOG.md and provenance report a PM drafts from it so spec-trio can consume them.
defaultPrompt: Use spec-forge to draft a spec from design-decision.md.
